limits: A receipt covers a file, not a statement: it shows that the file type-checks and which axioms the named declarations use. Whether a declaration states a node's claim is the job of the PFP reviews.

Axiom lists come from Lean.collectAxioms (the function behind #print axioms) run in a scratch file; the sources were not edited. A cited symbol resolves only to a constant whose full name is the symbol or ends in '.' + the symbol; a symbol with no such constant, or only several suffix matches and no exact one, is listed under unresolved_cited_symbols / ambiguous_cited_symbols and is not audited. axiom_audit_passed is true only if every cited symbol resolved and every audited axiom is standard; the whole-file theorem audit (axioms_whole_file_extra) is information and never sets it. When the DAG cites a file without naming a declaration, the audit is of every theorem of the file.

seconds is wall-clock for one `lake build` invocation while up to four independent modules were built side by side; it includes contention and, for a module whose dependencies were built just before, only that module's own compile.
